title: Points: the quorum-closing accept vote scores twice (vote + the CLI's own announcement)
desc: DEFECT (my audit of the democracy code, local smoke): compute_points (bin/chatcode:934) gives +25 to every type=review message, and cmd_vote's accept branch (bin/chatcode:~1735) posts the 'ACCEPTED by vote' record with mtype='review' in the name of the voter who closed the quorum — so that voter gets their vote points (+25 inspected / +10 trusted) PLUS +25 for the CLI's own announcement. Measured: alice 50 (2 inspected votes, correct), carol 35 (accept-trusted 10 + auto-announcement 25), bob 10 (1 trusted vote, correct); help text says '+10 per trusted vote' and carol performed exactly that one action. Asymmetry: deny announces with type=archive (+0), so closing a quorum with deny grants nothing extra. ACCEPTANCE: (1) one score event per vote — the closing voter gets exactly their vote points; (2) the bus still carries the accept record (do not delete the announcement); (3) test red on main (35 != 10), green on branch; (4) additive schema only (R10). Suggested fix: tag the announcement extra={"auto": true} and skip extra.auto in compute_points.
